Name: Jockey by TwelveLabs
Tagline: Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood
Description: Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Ingest YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Reels links; assemble content into MP4s; and create and share video-driven artifacts with playable clips. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration.

Name: Harness by Autonomous
Tagline: Every coding agent, every machine, one command center.
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Harness is the open-source command center for coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud: every agent on every machine, side by side. Use the native desktop app, hn in your terminal, or the iOS and Android app to answer agents by voice. End-to-end encrypted. Then go beyond code with 49 harnesses for CAD, circuits, robots, games and music. Free on Mac and Linux.

Name: Pomerado
Tagline: Turn any website into an API; 3x Fast & reliable browser use
Topics: API, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Pomerado turns any website into a MCP / API in minutes. Automate everything by turning previously inaccessible websites (like Google Flights, Zillow, Instacart, legacy portals) into native tools for your agents. Our open-source tool builds, hosts, authenticates, and maintains your integrations, so you can focus on building.

Name: Tesla Roadster
Tagline: The hypercar that flies
Description: Roadster can perform at levels unlike any other production car. It goes beyond Plaid to unlock an entirely new dimension of driving. It challenges the limits of design, engineering and physics to deliver an expertly crafted extra-terrestrial vehicle.

Name: Memory Chess
Tagline: Study a chess position, then rebuild it from memory
Description: Memory Chess shows you a chess position for a few seconds, clears the board, and you put the pieces back. Version 2.0 is our biggest update yet: a daily board everyone plays once, a skill rating that moves both ways, a dashboard of your memory span and progress, shareable round replays, and a redesign in 24 languages. Free, no account. Come say hi and swap scores with other players on Telegram: t.me/TheMemoryChess

Name: Fish Audio Drama 3
Tagline: AI voice acting you can direct, not just generate
Description: Drama 3 is Fish Audio's latest AI voice model, built for performances you can direct. Turn scripts into expressive speech with natural-language control over emotion, pacing, whispers, laughter, and pauses — even within a single sentence. Create multi-character scenes, audiobooks, game dialogue, and narration across 83 languages. Available on the web, mobile, and API, with open weights for self-hosting under Fish Audio's community license.

Name: Hintly for Google Meet™
Tagline: Real-time hints for every term you miss on Google Meet
Description: Hintly explains the terms, names and things people mention on your Google Meet calls, a moment after they come up.

Name: Parallax
Tagline: Every coding agent you run, in one place.
Description: Parallax runs your coding agents for you. Claude Code, Codex and 40+ more in one app, with 240+ models on your own subscriptions. Captain handles the busywork, fast merge ships your PRs in one click, and when a subscription runs out, auto fallback enables your work to move to the next.

Name: Firefox Enterprise
Tagline: Firefox for enterprises that want control of their data
Description: Firefox Enterprise brings Mozilla's independent browser technology to organizations that want more control over their IT infrastructure and data. Built on the Gecko engine, it offers a self-hosted management console for centrally managing browser policies, access, data movement, and AI usage. It works alongside existing identity, security, and device management systems, helping enterprises reduce dependence on dominant browser ecosystems.

Name: SignWith
Tagline: E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc.
Description: Sign 3 documents free every month, then buy one-time credit packs from $9. Every account gets signing order, email OTP verification, audit trail and certificate of completion. Send from the app, the API, or AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT using the MCP.

Name: Dottr
Tagline: AI Agent that drafts, flags risks and gets contracts signed.
Description: Dottr is an AI teammate for contracts that lives in your email. Forward a thread or notes and it drafts the agreement from your templates, reviews risks in plain English, sends it for signature, and chases every signer until it’s done. Signers need no login. It also remembers the terms and dates so you can ask what you agreed later. From draft to signed instantly, so the yes doesn’t go cold.

Name: VibeClock Minimalist Flip Clock
Tagline: Aesthetic flip clock & screensaver for deep work vibes
Description: VibeClock turns any idle monitor or browser tab into a gorgeous, distraction-free aesthetic desk clock. Packed with 40+ themes: retro flip clock, cozy animated cats, lo-fi vibes, dev environments, game consoles, and a native Chrome screensaver that kicks in when you step away.

Name: QuickEnrich
Tagline: B2B enrichment for the rows your GTM waterfall can’t fill
Description: Most gtm enrichment waterfalls rely on public LinkedIn data, so they miss up to 40% of an ICP, especially SMBs that barely use it. Quickenrich crawls the rest of the web and uses LLMs to find and reverify who’s who at each company. One API for Claude Code, Codex, Clay, or n8n.

Name: Taim
Tagline: Capture it. Taim files, schedules & syncs it with your AI.
Description: Taim is your thought-capture assistant. Speak your mind and it all falls into place: thoughts land in the right thread automatically, and to-dos become tasks, reminders, and calendar events. Connect via MCP, and every agent you use instantly has your context.

Name: Cursor Teleporter 2
Tagline: Teleport your Mac cursor between screens and saved positions
Description: Less mouse travel on your Mac. Jump between displays or saved cursor positions with a keyboard shortcut. Version 2 adds edge teleporting, cursor highlighting, and Apple Shortcuts and AppleScript support. Free 30-day trial. One-time purchase.

Name: Muse Spark Open
Tagline: The most capable US open weights model to date
Description: Meta's open weights model built for coding and agentic work. 816B total parameters with 42B active, a 1M token context window and native multimodal input. Download the weights on Hugging Face or run it on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with MLX.

Name: A Novel Appetite
Tagline: A vampire bookshop game — prey only on bad authors
Description: A Novel Appetite is a dark-comedy adventure game set in a vampire's bookshop. Run Aspen's bookshop by night — shelving, recommending, choosing dinner. You prey only on bad authors. Five nights, one fire, one awkward insurance claim — the shop is never quite the same. Adapted from the maker's book, with hand-cut paper visuals in silent-film style, an original score, and a story in verse. $1.99, pay once and play it all. No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No data collected. Works offline.

Name: GBrain Tools
Tagline: A password manager for AI
Description: GBrain Tools is a password manager for AI. Connect Gmail, GitHub, Stripe, Notion and many more once, then use them from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Cursor or your terminal. No AI holds a password, and every action lands on one log. $19 a month.

Name: talkflow
Tagline: 100% free, open-source, and private alternative to WisprFlow
Topics: Open Source, GitHub, Menu Bar Apps, Audio
Description: The free, open-source Wispr Flow alternative. Hold a key, speak, and your words are typed wherever your cursor is. Runs entirely on your Mac or PC.

Name: Brickbrag
Tagline: A massively multiplayer brick sandbox with real physics
Topics: Open World Games, Free Games, Crafting Games
Description: Brickbrag is a multiplayer brick sandbox: build anything you can imagine, brick by brick, together with everyone online. The bricks behave like real ones. They have weight, they only hold where studs hold them, and if your overhang is too big, it comes down. Find coins and trade them for new bricks. Need a break? Race on the track, fly from the airfield or ride robot-driven buses out to the volcano. Play free on desktop or phone, right in your browser.
